clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for  galvanized strand fencing wire of 3-ply and 7-ply construction. For detailed information, refer to  IS 2140 : 1978 Specifications for stranded galvanized steel wire for fencing (first revision).

clauses.title: Shall be manufactured from
clauses.text: 3.1 Shall be manufactured from galvanized mild steel wire conforming to IS 280 : 1978*. The wire shall have a tensile strength of 540 N/mm2, Min.

clauses.title: The galvanized Mild steel
clauses.text: 3.2 The galvanized Mild steel wire used shall conform to the requirements for galvanizing as laid down  for the' heavily- coated wire' or ' medium coated wire as per the prescribed standard. *  Mild steel wire for general engineering purposes (third revision).

clauses.title: Lay – Shall be
clauses.text: 4. Lay - Shall be right-hand. The strand shall be evenly and uniformly laid . The length  of the lay shall be as specified in 2.1 and 2.2.

clauses.title: Freedom from
clauses.text: 5. Freedom from  Defects -  Shall be free  from scale, irregularities,imperfections, flaws, sand- spilts and other defects. The galvanizing shall be smooth,  even and bright.

clauses.title: Minimum Breaking Load
clauses.text: 6.1 Minimum Breaking Load — As given in 2.1 and 2.2
